obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, inverse text on dark buttons

carbon.$description: Carbon — Section backgrounds, dark surface containers, large heading text

fog-white.$description: Fog White — Card backgrounds, subtle elevated surfaces, ghost button hover fills

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary body text, muted icon strokes, helper labels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Navigation text, inline link color, icon fills — softer than pure black for repeated text contexts

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Hairline borders, nav separators, disabled state fills

linen.$description: Linen — Card hover state, second-tier surface tint

ink.$description: Ink — High-emphasis nav text, logo wordmark, near-black fallback

smoke.$description: Smoke — Tertiary text, placeholder copy, scrollbar tracks

slate-whisper.$description: Slate Whisper — Muted metadata, caption text, minor UI labels

openai-sans.$description: Sole typeface across all surfaces. Weight 400 for body, 500 for nav and card titles, 600 for the page hero headline. The tight negative letter-spacing (-0.008em to -0.02em) pulls characters together for a dense, editorial feel at every size.
